summary: Golub Capital Private Income Fund I filed an 8-K reporting routine periodic events: an exempt unregistered sale of 87,386 common shares at $24.22 NAV per share for $2.1M total under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D; a regular monthly distribution of $0.1667 per share declared May 1, 2026 payable June 29, 2026; and standard portfolio commentary for April 2026. No M&A, tender, spin-off, activist, or other special-situation event is present. The filing is a routine current report updating ordinary capital raising and distribution activity.
